meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 在 agent 容器里安装 Vercel CLI,并在 OneCLI 中配置 api.vercel.com 的凭证注入,让 NanoClaw agent 能把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel,部署时用 vercel deploy 等命令。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发,例如运行 /add-vercel;前提是 OneCLI 已就绪,否则会先提示运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 用 /add-vercel 给我的 agent 加上 Vercel 部署能力
say.note: 先检查 OneCLI 与是否已安装

say.text: 跑 onecli secrets list 看看 Vercel 凭证配好了没
say.note: 没有则会引导创建 token

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials for api.vercel.com, so NanoClaw agents can deploy web apps to Vercel with commands like vercel deploy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel, e.g. by running /add-vercel. OneCLI must be set up first, or it tells you to run /init-onecli.

say_en.text: Run /add-vercel to give my agent Vercel deployment ability
say_en.note: Checks OneCLI and existing install first

say_en.text: Here is my Vercel token; add it to OneCLI for api.vercel.com
say_en.note: Stores credential and assigns it to agents

say_en.text: Check with onecli secrets list whether the Vercel credential is set
say_en.note: If missing, it guides token creation
